windows.reason: the interior is shut for winter - F-roads stay gated until the snow clears and the rivers drop to a fordable depth
opening in stages through the month; F208 to Landmannalaugar usually falls around 10-20 June, and the road administration sets each road's date on inspection rather than in advance
the full network is normally open and the river crossings are at their most manageable
roads start closing again as the first snows arrive; check the official road status the morning you drive

activities.name: Natural ice caves (Vatnajokull)
activities.note: the natural caves melt and become unsafe outside the cold months; the year-round man-made ice tunnel is a different trip

windows.reason: the glacier is cold enough for the natural caves to be stable, and guided tours run

activities.name: Puffin colonies
activities.note: outside the nesting window the birds are out at sea and the colonies are empty

windows.reason: the Atlantic puffins are ashore to nest and boat tours to the colonies run

activities.name: Laugavegur trek
activities.note: the huts and the highland bus link close with the F-roads

windows.reason: the trail is clear of snow, the huts are staffed and the highland buses run
the edges of the season - it opens with the F-roads around mid-June and winds down through September
